contract.name: Plan-Do-See Diary Firestore Data Contract
contract.description: Cloud Firestore collections, document structures, browser SDK direct access rules, and diary operational constraints aligned with implementation-plan.md.
contract.implementationStatus: Draft contract updated. Client-side Firestore SDK direct connection on Firebase Hosting without server runtime.

database.locationPolicy: Choose the Firestore location before database creation. Location cannot be changed after creation.

deployment.sourceRepository: Shared repository for T06 and T07. T06 submission is pinned to an immutable full commit hash.
deployment.databaseAccess: Browser-side Firebase Client SDK directly. No Node.js/Admin SDK server backend in T06.

documentIds.apiAndExportRule: Export document ID as 'id' in JSON export; do not rely on document order for identity.

relationships.representation: Foreign keys stored as Firestore document ID strings (planId, taskId).
relationships.referentialIntegrity: Enforced via client-side transaction/batch logic. Cascading trash transitions applied explicitly.

timestamps.meaning: Absolute UTC instant generated by Firestore serverTimestamp().
timestamps.apiAndExportFormat: ISO 8601 UTC string ending in Z

durations.displayRule: Display in hours and minutes (e.g. 90분 or 1시간 30분) representing the same stored integer.

text.storageRule: Store user input as raw plain text without HTML encoding in database.
text.renderingRule: Always render as text nodes in DOM; never use innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
text.sensitiveDataRule: No login authentication in T06. The warning message must be displayed on the cover: '지금은 로그인이 없어 링크를 아는 사람은 누구나 볼 수 있습니다. 남이 봐도 괜찮은 내용만 넣으세요'

plans.purpose: Current editable plan document. Plan ID remains immutable across revisions.
invariants: When plan mutable fields are edited, full snapshot of prior state must be written to planRevisions in the same transaction.

planRevisions.purpose: Immutable snapshot of plan content immediately before an update.
planRevisions.writePolicy: Created exclusively inside the Firestore runTransaction that updates the plan document.

completedAt.constraints: Must be set when status is 'done', set to null when reopened.

invariants: Referenced plan must exist and have trashStatus != 1.
Tasks with trashStatus == 1 are hidden from default active and scheduled lists.
Updating task status to done sets completedAt; reverting to in_progress clears completedAt.

executionLogs.purpose: Append-only record of actual work done. Does not mutate plan or task estimates.

actualMinutes.meaning: Calculated duration between endedAt and startedAt at client runtime (endedAt - startedAt). Stored startedAt and endedAt timestamps are the source of truth for duration.

invariants: Creating an execution log never updates planned values or creates plan revisions.

steps: If title, period, priority, success criteria, or estimatedMinutes changed, create new planRevisions document with old snapshot and revisionNumber = plan.revisionCount + 1.
Update plan fields and increment revisionCount in the same transaction.

completeTask.idempotencyRule: If task.status is already 'done', abort transaction without modification. Ensure repeated button clicks produce exactly one state transition.
steps: Check task.status. If status === 'done', no-op / return early.
Update task status to 'done', set completedAt to serverTimestamp(), updatedAt to serverTimestamp().
Update status to 'in_progress', set completedAt to null, and update updatedAt.
For plan: set plan.trashStatus = 1, plan.trashedAt = serverTimestamp(), and update all child tasks and executionLogs to trashStatus = 1.
For task: set task.trashStatus = 1, task.trashedAt = serverTimestamp(), and update all child executionLogs to trashStatus = 1.
For executionLog: set executionLog.trashStatus = 1, trashedAt = serverTimestamp().
Set target document(s) trashStatus = 2 (restored state) and clear trashedAt to null.

scheduledTaskList.dateRange: KST today to same day next month (startDate based)

completedTaskList.dateRange: Same day last month to today in KST (completedAt based)

queryAndSortPolicy.visibleSortDisclosure: Display active sort order explicitly in UI header (e.g. '정렬 기준: 마감일 오름차순 → 우선순위(높음 우선) → 제목 가나다순 → ID순').

review.timeRange: Calendar date range [startCalendarDate, endCalendarDate] in KST.

metrics.name: planCount
metrics.definition: Count plans where trashStatus != 1 and period overlaps with selected calendar range.

metrics.name: completedTaskCount
metrics.definition: Count tasks where trashStatus != 1, status == 'done', and completedAt falls within selected calendar range.

metrics.name: executionLogCount
metrics.definition: Count executionLogs where trashStatus != 1 and startedAt falls within selected calendar range.

metrics.name: averageTimeVariance
metrics.definition: Average of (actualMinutes - estimatedMinutes) for completed tasks having execution logs within selected range.

review.navigationInvariant: Clicking any aggregate number navigates to the dedicated list/breakdown view of the contributing records.

shape.exportedAt: ISO 8601 UTC string ending in Z

securityAndPrivacy.authentication: None in T06; public read/write per security rules with strict payload schema validation.
securityAndPrivacy.publicWarning: Mandatory cover notice: '지금은 로그인이 없어 링크를 아는 사람은 누구나 볼 수 있습니다. 남이 봐도 괜찮은 내용만 넣으세요'
securityAndPrivacy.xssDefense: All text rendered strictly as text nodes (DOM textContent/React JSX text), avoiding HTML execution.
